00043     virtual double& process (double& sig) {
00044         double dc = m_block->process (sig);    
00045         
00046         for (int i = 0; i < m_num; i++) {
00047             m_filtered[i] = dc;
00048             for (int k = 0; k < m_levels; k++) {
00049                 m_filtered[i] = 
00050                     m_filters[(i * m_levels) + k]->fastProcess (m_filtered[i]);
00051             }
00052             m_followed[i] = m_envFollowers[i]->process (m_filtered[i]);
00053             m_periods[i] = m_zeroes[i]->process (m_filtered[i]);
00054         }
00055         double max = findMax (m_followed, m_num);
00056         //std::cout << "max : " << max << std::endl;
00057         int filt = 0;
00058         if (max < m_threshold) {       
00059             m_val = -1;  
00060         }
00061         else {
00062             double maxSplit = max / m_split;
00063             m_val = -1;
00064             while (filt < m_num) {  
00065                 if (m_followed[filt] >= maxSplit) {
00066                     if (m_periods[filt] <= m_bins[filt] && m_periods[filt] >= m_min) {
00067                             m_val = m_final->process (m_periods[filt]);
00068                         break;
00069                     }        
00070                     else if (filt < m_num - 1 && m_periods[filt] <= m_bins[filt + 1] 
00071                         && m_periods[filt] >= m_min) {
00072                             m_val = m_final->process (m_periods[filt]);    
00073                         break;
00074                     }
00075                     else {
00076                        break;
00077                     }
00078                 }    
00079                 filt++;  
00080             }   
00081         }       
00082         
00083         return m_val;
00084     }
